description: Technical potential for solar photovoltaic production on roofs is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. This data set presents, for each building on the Island of Montreal, an estimate of the technical solar photovoltaic potential of roofs, i.e.: the identified roof area, the installable photovoltaic capacity (expressed in nominal DC power of the panels), as well as the average annual electricity production that can be generated.This third party metadata element ... Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Photovoltaics, SeNV, Solar energy, Government information, Photovoltaique. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GPKG, HTML. The portal shows 2026-06-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
